name: White Leyline Attunement
description: When you Draw Mana, allies you can see within Attunement Range regain health equal to your tier.

name: Concordant Presence
description: When an ally you can see within Attunement Range succeeds on a test, the next ally testing that same skill this round raises the stakes.
flavor: Success leaves a wake. Learn to swim in it.

name: Guiding Signal
description: Spend 1 Investiture to designate a character within Attunement Range. The next ally who tests against it this round raises the stakes.
flavor: Point. Trust. Watch them find the same line.

name: Unity of Purpose
description: When two or more allies aid the same test, raise the stakes.
flavor: Two hands lift more than twice what one can carry.

name: Beacon of Stability
description: When you Draw Mana, spend 1 Investiture to remove one condition from an ally within Attunement Range.
flavor: When one would falter, together we stand.

name: Shared Conviction
description: When an ally within Attunement Range would fail a test, you may spend 2 focus and 1 Investiture to add your White modifier to their result. This may change the outcome.
flavor: You almost had it. Now you do.
tags: reaction; focus; coordination; buff; ally; investiture

name: Ordered Advance
description: Spend 1 Investiture. This round, when you move, allies within 10 ft may move half their Speed without provoking Reactions.
flavor: One step sets the rhythm. The rest find their place.

name: Mending Aura
description: You may spend Opportunity to restore half [Tier][Die] health to each ally within [Size].
flavor: When the moment presents itself, the formation renews.

name: Pillar of Order
description: When an ally within Attunement Range rolls a Complication, spend 1 Investiture to change it to a blank face.
flavor: Make a problem into a possibility.

name: Guardian Stance
description: While an ally is adjacent to you, you both gain +1 Deflect.
flavor: Stand close.

name: Interposing Shield
description: When an ally within 10 feet takes damage, move up to 10 feet toward them and reduce that damage by half [Die].
flavor: Distance is not an excuse. It never was.

name: Retributive Guard
description: When an ally adjacent to you takes damage from an enemy within Attunement Range, spend 1 Investiture to test White vs. Spiritual defense. On a success, deal [Tier][Die] spirit damage to the attacker.
flavor: Hurt my people. Find out what that costs.

name: Shared Burden
description: When an ally adjacent to you takes damage, spend 2 Investiture. If you do, take half that damage in their place.
flavor: You carry your share. Then theirs.

name: Devoted Conduit
description: When an ally within Attunement Range takes damage intended for another creature, reduce that damage by half [Tier][Die].
flavor: The burden passes through you. So does the strength to bear it.

name: Shield Wall
description: When two or more allies are adjacent to you, attacks against them deal half [Tier][Die] less damage.
flavor: Together, the wall holds. That's the whole idea.

name: Unbreakable Line
description: Once per round, when an ally adjacent to you would drop to 0 health, spend 3 Investiture and test White with a DC equal to 1/2 of the damage taken. On a success, they drop to 1 health instead.
flavor: The line does not break. Not here. Not now.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 maximum health per level, including previous levels.
flavor: The leyline doesn't just heal you. It makes you harder to break.

name: Terms of Accord
description: When you and a character within Attunement Range verbally agree on a shared objective, spend 1 Investiture. You both gain +1 to tests pursuing the objective for the scene. One active accord per creature.
flavor: "Shall we?"

name: Counterpoint
description: When an enemy within Attunement Range successfully influences an ally, test White. On a success, you may spend 1 Investiture to negate the effect and Disorient the enemy until the end of your next turn.
flavor: Every argument has a counter. Speak it.

name: Disciplined Mind
description: You and allies within Attunement Range reduce the focus cost to resist influence by 1 (minimum 1).
flavor: You've learned to recognize the shape of persuasion before it takes hold. So have those near you.

name: Overwhelming Authority
description: When you successfully influence a character, spend 1 Investiture. The target also becomes Disoriented until the end of your next turn.

name: Bound by Word
description: When an ally within Attunement Range acts in pursuit of an active accord's objective, they may use your White modifier in place of their own.

name: Collective Resolve
description: You can spend an Opportunity and 1 Investiture to gran allies within Attunement Range Determined.
flavor: One voice finds the note. The rest follow.

name: Unyielding Accord
description: Allies within Attunement Range gain +1 to Cognitive and Spiritual defenses while adjacent to another ally.
flavor: Stand together. Not because you have to - because you chose to.
tags: passive; accord; defense; buff; ally; leadership

name: Voice of Authority
description: When an enemy within Attunement Range targets an ally with a hostile action, spend 1 Investiture to impose disadvantage.
flavor: A word, placed correctly, lands harder than a blade.
tags: reaction; investiture; accord; disadvantage; defense; ally

name: Blue Leyline Attunement
description: When you Draw Mana, gain an advantage on your next Cognitive test.

name: Forewarned
description: At the start of each round, silently declare one character and one action type. If that character takes the declared action before your next turn, you gain 1 Reaction.
flavor: You saw this coming before they decided it.

name: Intercept
description: When a creature you designated with Forewarned takes the declared action, spend 1 Investiture to impose disadvantage on that action.

name: Telepathic Network
description: You communicate telepathically with characters within Attunement Range for the scene. Allies in the network share your expertise.

name: Calculated Patience
description: When you take a slow turn, your first test that turn gains advantage.
flavor: Patience is not hesitation.

name: Reactive Analysis
description: When a character within Attunement Range fails a test, spend 1 Investiture to gain an advantage on your next test against them.
flavor: Every stumble is a lesson if you're paying attention.

name: Probable Outcome
description: After all creatures choose fast or slow turn, you may change your choice.

name: Read Intent
description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Blue against a creature's Cognitive defense. On success, the GM reveals what action that creature intends to take next round.

name: Collected
description: Increase your Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

name: Subtle Suggestion
description: When you successfully influence a character, you may spend 1 Investiture. The target also becomes Disoriented until the start of your next turn.
flavor: The best manipulation feels like the target's own idea.

name: Redirect Momentum
description: When a character within Attunement Range moves, spend 1 Investiture to test Blue vs. Athletics. On a success, reduce its remaining movement by [Size] or push it [Size] feet in any direction.
flavor: You can slip on something that's not even there.

name: Phantom Step
description: When an ally within Attunement Range moves, they may move an additional [Size] feet without provoking Reactions.
flavor: Extra maneuverability, extra problems.

name: Holographic Illusion
description: Spend 1 Investiture to create a static illusion within Attunement Range not exceeding [Size]. The illusion lasts for the scene. Use a Free Action to make minor adjustments to it.
flavor: On far away worlds, this is called Lightweaving.

name: Phantom Barricade
description: Spend 1 Investiture to create a shimmering barrier at a point within Attunement Range. It has health equal to 2[Die] and lasts for the scene or until destroyed. The barricade provides cover and blocks movement.
flavor: "Where did that wall come from?"

name: Ghostly Walls
description: Choose a character you can influence within Attunement Range and spend 2 Investiture to test Blue vs. Cognitive. On success, the target's movement rate becomes 0 until end of your next turn.
flavor: It's hard to move when the walls close in.

name: Living Image
description: Your illusions can move up to your movement rate and interact with the environment. Use an Action to have your illusion perform something requiring your attention, such as a conversation. Complex illusions cost 1 Investiture per round to maintain.
flavor: A convincing copy, to be sure.

name: Absolute Stillness
description: Creatures you have reduced to 0 Speed also has disadvantage on Physical tests and cannot take Reactions.

name: Phantom Double
description: Spend 2 Investiture. Create an illusory duplicate of yourself or an ally within Attunement Range; it appears adjacent to the original and has 1 health. Each enemy who can see it tests Perception against your Cognitive defense: on a failure they lose track of the original — only the duplicate is real to them; on a success the duplicate is empty air to them. Any hit destroys the duplicate, and the original stands plainly seen again.
flavor: Which one is real? Neither. Both. Does it matter?

name: Pattern Recognition
description: When you succeed on a Cognitive test against a character, you may spend 1 Investiture. If you do, their next test this round has disadvantage.
flavor: You don't need to predict them. You just need to understand them.

name: Composed
description: Increase your maximum focus by your tier.

name: Counterspell
description: When a character within Attunement Range spends Investiture to activate a talent, spend 2 focus and 1 Investiture to test Blue vs. their Cognitive defense. On a success, the talent fails.
flavor: Every talent has a flaw in its logic. Find it fast enough, and it unravels.

name: Anticipate
description: When you or an ally in your Telepathic Network would be targeted by an influence effect, spend 1 Investiture to give that character an advantage on their resistance test.
flavor: The math was always going to end here.

name: False Premise
description: When a character within Attunement Range succeeds on a Cognitive test, spend 1 Investiture and test Blue vs. their Cognitive defense. On a success, impose disadvantage on their next test.

name: Probability Cascade
description: You may spend an Opportunity and 1 Investiture to give a creature within Attunement Range disadvantage on its next two tests.

name: Baleful
description: To resist your influence, a character must spend additional focus equal to your tier.
flavor: The weight of being truly understood cannot be easily shrugged off.

name: Black Leyline Attunement
description: When you Draw Mana, enemies you can see within Attunement Range with no ally within 5 feet become Weakened.

name: Predatory Patience
description: When you attack a Weakened creature, add [Die] to the test. On a successful attack against a Weakened creature, regain 1 Investiture.
flavor: It doesn't know you're hunting it yet.

name: Sapping Hex
description: When you hit an Isolated character (one with no ally within 5 feet), it becomes Weakened.
flavor: The hex sets in the moment they realize no one is coming.

name: Spoils of Isolation
description: Spend 1 Investiture. Each Weakened character within Attunement Range takes vital damage equal to your tier. You gain Temporary HP equal to the total vital damage dealt.
flavor: Stand still. This won't take long.
tags: damage; vital_damage; isolation; weakened; temp_hp; area

name: Severance
description: Your attacks against Isolated characters deal vital damage instead of their normal damage type.
flavor: Alone, they have nothing left to hide behind.

name: Cruel Step
description: Spend 1 Investiture to move 10 feet towards an Isolated character within Attunement Range without provoking Reactive Strikes.
flavor: The gap opens. You're already through it.

name: Unnerving Approach
description: Once per turn, when you move adjacent to an enemy, spend 1 Investiture. Choose one character allied to that enemy within 10 ft and push it [Size] feet directly away, potentially leaving the target Isolated.
flavor: One step. Their formation shatters.

name: Dread Presence
description: Weakened characters within Attunement Range cannot willingly move closer to any allies.
flavor: They look to their allies. Their legs refuse to carry them.

name: Sovereign of Solitude
description: When a Weakened creature within Attunement Range moves, spend 2 Investiture to reduce its movement rate to 0. Test Black vs. Spiritual, rolling [Tier][Die] vital damage on a success.
flavor: You may go nowhere. You may do nothing. You are mine.
tags: reaction; isolation; weakened; vital_damage; damage; control; investiture

name: Blood Price
description: When you lose health to activate a Ritual talent, gain an advantage on your next Black test.
flavor: The leyline learns the taste of you - and pays in kind, briefly, for what it takes.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 maximum HP per level, including previous levels.
flavor: The body that bleeds often learns to hold more blood.

name: Withering Ray
description: Lose half [Die] health, then make a ranged Black attack vs. Spiritual against a character within Attunement Range. On a hit, deal 2[Tier][Die] vital damage.
flavor: Some draw a blade. The Ritualist draws from themselves - and from the wounds, something answers.

name: Necrotic Grasp
description: When you hit a character with a Black attack, the healing it receives is halved until the end of your next turn.
flavor: The wound remembers. Bind it, stitch it, pray over it - the ritual's mark forbids it to close.

name: Dark Investiture
description: Spend 1 Investiture and lose health equal to your tier, then test Black vs. Spiritual of a character within Attunement Range. On a success, the target takes [Tier][Die] vital damage and becomes Afflicted [[Tier][Die] vital].
flavor: A name spoken in the right language sticks to the soul.

name: Sanguine Reservoir
description: When you lose health from a Ritual talent, store the lost amount as Reserve, up to a maximum equal to your ranks in Black. You may spend Reserve as Investiture.
flavor: Every drop is owed. Every drop is remembered. The reservoir keeps a ledger only its master can read.

name: Double Dip
description: Spend 2 Investiture and test Black vs. Cognitive of a character within Attunement Range. On a success, for the scene, you may spend Reserve in place of health for Ritual talents that target that character.
flavor: Mark them once with the proper words, and every cut after pours into the same cup.

name: Predator's Due
description: When you reduce a character to 0 health, regain [Tier][Die] health and 1 Investiture.
flavor: A life for a life - and a measure of the spark that animated it

name: Siphoned Will
description: When you successfully apply Hollow Command to a creature, regain focus equal to your tier.
flavor: Their silence fills you.

name: Coercive Pressure
description: When a character within Attunement Range loses focus, it has a disadvantage on its next Cognitive test. Once per round per character.
flavor: Each thought spent is a stone removed from the wall — and the wall is what kept the doubt out.

name: Predatory Insight
description: When you roll an Opportunity, you may spend it and 1 Investiture to gain an advantage on your next Deception test this round. Regain 1 focus when any character reaches 0 focus.

name: Extract Thought
description: When you succeed on a Deception test against a character, it cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn.
flavor: Pull one thread, and the whole tapestry of intention unravels.

name: Whispered Doubt
description: When an enemy within Attunement Range spends focus, it spends 1 additional focus. Once per round per enemy.
flavor: A voice asking "are you sure?" — pitched just below hearing, never absent — costs more than it should.

name: Composed
description: Increase your maximum focus by your tier.

name: Hollow Command
description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Deception vs. Spiritual of a character within Attunement Range. On a success, the target cannot take actions on its next turn.

name: Puppeteer
description: When a character within Attunement Range with 0 focus takes its turn, spend 2 focus and 1 Investiture to choose one of its actions on that turn.
flavor: The strings were tied long before the dance. You merely call the step.

name: Red Leyline Attunement
description: When you Draw Mana, gain an advantage on your next Physical test. Lose your Reaction until the start of your next turn.

name: Burning Drive
description: On a fast turn, add half [Die] to your first Physical test.

name: Reckless Advance
description: Spend 1 Investiture to move [Size] feet toward a character or objective without provoking reactions.

name: Volatile Strike
description: When you hit with a melee attack, spend 1 Investiture and test Red vs. Physical to add half [Tier][Die] impact damage.

name: Momentum's Edge
description: When you Strike a creature after moving at least 20 feet toward it this turn, the attack deals bonus impact damage equal to your Speed.
flavor: Speed is the weapon. Distance is the wind-up.

name: Shockwave Slam
description: When you hit with a melee Physical test, push the target up to [Size] ft. Collision with an obstacle deals half [Tier][Die] Impact.

name: Explosive Leap
description: Move up to [Size] ft without provoking Reactions. Creatures within 5 ft of where you land test Physical or fall Prone.

name: Reckless Momentum
description: When you succeed on a Physical test, spend Opportunity to roll the Plot Die on your next test this turn.

name: Unstoppable
description: When you deal damage on a Fast turn, move up to half your Speed without provoking Reactions. Once per turn.

name: Kindle
description: When dealing energy damage, add additional damage equal to your Red modifier. Creatures you deal energy damage to shed light in 5 ft and lose concealment benefits until end of your next turn.

name: Searing Bolt
description: Spend 1 Investiture and make a Red ranged attack test against a character you can sense within Attunement Range, rolling [Tier][Die] energy damage on a success.

name: Flame Surge
description: Spend 2 Investiture. Each character within [Size] of a point in Attunement Range tests Athletics vs. Red. On a failure, they take [Tier][Die] energy damage, and half as much on a success.

name: Arc Flash
description: When you deal energy damage to a character, you may spend 1 Investiture. If you do, a bolt arcs to one other character within 10 feet, dealing half [Tier][Die] energy damage. Once per round.

name: Flashpoint
prerequisites: Flame Surge or Arc Flash; Red 1+
description: Once per round, when a Red talent you activate hits two or more characters, choose: all affected characters lose a Reaction, OR regain 1 Investiture and gain an advantage on your next Red test this turn.
flavor: Spread the fire. Then decide what you've bought.

name: Mighty
description: When you hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, for each action spent, deal extra damage equal to 1 + your tier.

name: Afterburn
description: When you deal energy damage, you may spend an Opportunity to inflict Afflicted[half [Tier][Die] energy] on the target.

name: Chain Detonation
description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Red Conflagration talent, deal half [Tier][Die] energy damage to each creature within 5 ft.

name: Incite
description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Intimidation vs. Spiritual of a character within Attunement Range. On a success, it must Strike the nearest character or lose its Reaction
flavor: The thrum of anger slips beneath the skin; thought drowns in heat, and the blade lifts of its own accord.

name: Emotional Overload
description: When a character within Attunement Range gains an advantage from any source, spend 1 Investiture. It gains a disadvantage on its next non-attack test.
flavor: Confidence is a fragile thing - a single misplaced surge of feeling can shatter it.

name: Battle Fever
description: Each time damage is dealt within Attunement Range, you and allies gain +1 to your next test (max = Rank). Resets at start of your turn.

name: Shatter Focus
description: When a character within Attunement Range fails a test, use this Reaction and it loses 1 focus.
flavor: Failure tastes like ash.

name: Reckless Gambit
description: You may spend Opportunity and 1 Investiture to grant advantage to a character within Attunement Range on its next test. It then becomes Exhausted[-2].
flavor: Pride is a wound that bleeds twice.

name: Feeding Frenzy
description: When an enemy within Attunement Range attacks another enemy (you and each ally within range gain +1 to your next test this round. Resets at start of your turn.
flavor: Let them eat each other. Feed on the chaos.

name: Frenzied Tempo
description: When you take a Fast turn, your Influence tests gain an advantage until end of turn.

name: Breaking Point
description: When a character within Attunement Range takes damage for the second time in a round, spend 1 Investiture. It becomes Disoriented. Once per round per character.
flavor: The second blow is the one that breaks them.

name: Green Leyline Attunement
description: When you Draw Mana, create difficult terrain within [Size] of a point in Attunement Range.

name: Primal Awareness
description: You can't be Surprised while outdoors. Gain Advantage on Perception tests to detect or track creatures.
flavor: The land remembers every footfall. So do you.

name: Grasping Vines
description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Green vs. Physical defense of a character within Attunement Range. On a success, the target becomes Restrained. Spend 1 Investiture at the start of your turn to maintain the vines.
flavor: Roots don't ask. They just hold.

name: Territorial Instinct
description: When an enemy in your Attunement Range tries to Disengage, spend 1 Investiture and test Green vs. Survival to reduce its movement to 0 this turn.
flavor: You don't leave my land unless I let you.

name: Thorn Field
description: Your difficult terrain deals half [Tier][Die] keen damage to characters that enter or start their turn in it.
flavor: The ground doesn't forgive trespassers. It just takes its time.

name: Spreading Roots
description: When a character ends their turn in your difficult terrain, you may spend 1 Investiture to have the terrain expand [Size].
flavor: The ground remembers. It keeps growing.

name: Sudden Growth
description: Spend an Opportunity and 1 Investiture to create difficult terrain within [Size] of a character you can sense.
flavor: Some roots take hold at the first opportunity.

name: Pack Sense
description: When an ally makes an attack test against a character in your difficult terrain, spend 1 Investiture. If you do, they add your Green modifier to the result.
flavor: On your territory, your allies move like they've always known the land.

name: Apex Predator
description: While three or more enemies are within your difficult terrain, gain an advantage on all Physical tests.
flavor: Three enemies in your territory aren't a threat. They're a decision already made.

name: Mender's Instinct
description: When an ally in Attunement Range drops to half health or below, spend 1 Investiture to restore [Tier][Die] health to them.
flavor: You don't decide to help. You already have.

name: Verdant Mend
description: Spend 1 Investiture and touch a character to restore health equal to [Tier][Die] + your Green modifier.
flavor: Life finds a way back. You just have to show it the door.

name: Resurgent Growth
description: When you restore health to an ally with a Green talent, that ally regains health equal to your tier + your Green modifier at the start of your next turn while they remain within Attunement Range.
flavor: Life gives twice. The second gift grows quiet.

name: Natural Recovery
description: When you restore health with a Green talent, you may spend an Opportunity to also remove one condition from the target: Afflicted, Disoriented, Stunned, or Weakened.
flavor: The body already knows how to heal. Sometimes it just needs reminding.

name: Hardy
description: Gain +1 maximum health per level, including previous levels.

name: Collected
description: Increase your Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

name: Reknit Form
description: Spend 2 Investiture and touch a creature to remove one temporary injury, or spend 3 Investiture to remove a permanent injury.

name: Vital Surge
description: When you restore health to a character below half health, spend 1 Investiture to also grant them Temporary HP equal to half [Tier][Die].
flavor: Healing closes the wound. Vitality makes sure it stays closed.

name: Predator's Instinct
description: Gain an advantage on tests to track or locate characters suffering an injury or below half health. You can sense fear in characters within 30 feet without testing.
flavor: Something shifts in the eyes just before prey runs. You learned to read that shift long ago.

name: Pack Hunter
description: When you move adjacent to an enemy character another ally is adjacent to, spend 1 Investiture. You both gain an advantage on your next attack test against it.
flavor: A pack doesn't surround prey by accident.

name: Scent the Weak
description: You know which creature within Attunement Range has the lowest HP. Your first test against it each round gains advantage.

name: Pack Pressure
description: You and each ally within 15 feet may Move up to half their movement rate without provoking Reactive Strikes. Until the start of your next turn, when you or an ally adjacent to the same character Strikes it, that Strike deals an extra [Tier][Die] damage.

name: Coordinated Hunt
description: When you and at least one ally both make attack tests against the same character in the same round, each attack deals bonus damage equal to the number of different attackers who targeted it this round (maximum = Rank).
flavor: The pack does not hunt. The pack is the hunt.

name: Drive the Prey
description: Choose a character within 30 feet. Test Green vs. Survival. On a success, that character is Slowed and must move away from you on their next turn. Allies may make Reactive Strikes against it if it moves within their reach.

name: Packmate's Warning
description: When an ally within 10 ft is targeted by an attack they can't see, grant them +2 to their defense against it.

name: Natural Order
description: Spend 2 Investiture. For the scene, enemies within your Attunement Range cannot benefit from illusions, magical concealment, or advantage gained from deception.
